contested_claim: Routine PSA screening reduces prostate cancer mortality more than it harms.
proposed_consensual: Routine PSA screening detects more early prostate cancers than symptom-based referral.
why_uncontested: Increased detection is the undisputed mechanism of screening; the dispute is net mortality benefit.

contested_claim: Antidepressants outperform placebo by a clinically meaningful margin.
proposed_consensual: Antidepressants outperform placebo on standardized depression rating scales.
why_uncontested: The scale difference is undisputed; the dispute is whether it is clinically meaningful.

contested_claim: Egg consumption materially elevates cardiovascular risk in healthy adults.
proposed_consensual: Egg consumption supplies materially all dietary cholesterol in healthy adults.
why_uncontested: Compositional fact; the dispute is the downstream cardiovascular effect.

contested_claim: Population-wide salt reduction lowers cardiovascular risk.
proposed_consensual: Population-wide salt reduction lowers average measured blood pressure.
why_uncontested: The blood-pressure effect is established; the dispute is the cardiovascular outcome.

contested_claim: Vitamin D supplementation lessens the rate of respiratory infections.
proposed_consensual: Vitamin D supplementation raises circulating levels of the vitamin.
why_uncontested: Pharmacokinetic fact; the dispute is the infection outcome.

contested_claim: A regulated market in human kidneys would save more lives than it costs.
proposed_consensual: A transplanted kidney would give the recipient more expected years than dialysis.
why_uncontested: Survival advantage of transplantation over dialysis is undisputed; the dispute is the market.

contested_claim: Negative campaign advertising measurably depresses overall voter turnout.
proposed_consensual: Negative campaign advertising measurably raises viewer recall of the sponsor.
why_uncontested: Recall advantage is a robust finding; the dispute is the turnout effect.

contested_claim: Term limits shift real legislative power toward unelected staff.
proposed_consensual: Term limits shorten the average tenure of state legislators.
why_uncontested: Direct mechanical consequence; the dispute is where power moves.

contested_claim: Foreign aid accelerates GDP growth in poor recipient countries.
proposed_consensual: Foreign aid finances a substantial share of health spending in poor recipient countries.
why_uncontested: Accounting fact; the dispute is the growth effect.

contested_claim: Genetic differences explain most adult variation in measured intelligence.
proposed_consensual: Genetic differences explain most adult variation in measured human height.
why_uncontested: Height heritability in adults is undisputed; intelligence heritability is the live dispute.

contested_claim: A fixed biological upper limit bounds the human lifespan.
proposed_consensual: Documented human lifespan tops out near one hundred twenty years.
why_uncontested: The observed maximum is undisputed; whether a hard biological limit causes it is the dispute.

contested_claim: The gut microbiome causally shapes human mood and behavior.
proposed_consensual: The gut microbiome breaks down dietary fibers the human gut cannot digest.
why_uncontested: Established metabolic function; the dispute is the behavioral effect.

contested_claim: Conscious perception depends on posterior cortical activity rather than prefrontal broadcasting.
proposed_consensual: Conscious visual perception depends on cortical activity rather than retinal signalling alone.
why_uncontested: Cortical necessity is undisputed; which cortical region suffices is the dispute.

contested_claim: String theory qualifies as science rather than untestable mathematics.
proposed_consensual: String theory requires more spatial dimensions than the three we observe.
why_uncontested: Property of the formalism; the dispute is its scientific status.

contested_claim: Cosmic inflation best explains the universe's large-scale uniformity.
proposed_consensual: The cosmic microwave background displays large-scale temperature uniformity across the sky.
why_uncontested: Observation; the dispute is which mechanism explains it.

contested_claim: Undiscovered particles explain dark matter rather than modified gravity.
proposed_consensual: Galaxy rotation curves stay flatter than visible mass alone would predict.
why_uncontested: The observation is undisputed; its explanation is the dispute.

contested_claim: Low-dose ionizing radiation risk rises linearly to zero dose.
proposed_consensual: High-dose ionizing radiation raises measured cancer risk in exposed populations.
why_uncontested: High-dose risk is undisputed; extrapolation to low dose is the dispute.

contested_claim: A person's language detectably shapes color perception.
proposed_consensual: Languages divide the colour spectrum into detectably different numbers of basic terms.
why_uncontested: Cross-linguistic fact; the dispute is the perceptual consequence.

contested_claim: Human grammar rests on an innate faculty rather than general learning.
proposed_consensual: Human children acquire spoken grammar earlier than they acquire written literacy.
why_uncontested: Developmental ordering is undisputed; innateness is the dispute.

contested_claim: Low replication rates in psychology mainly reflect false original findings.
proposed_consensual: Replication attempts in psychology mainly report effects of reduced magnitude.
why_uncontested: The effect-size shrinkage is the observed datum; its interpretation is the dispute.

contested_claim: Heavy online-platform use poses a material risk for adolescent depression.
proposed_consensual: Heavy online-platform use occupies a material share of adolescent daily hours.
why_uncontested: Time-use measurement; the mental-health effect is the dispute.

contested_claim: German expansionism chiefly explains the First World War.
proposed_consensual: The First World War drew German forces into a prolonged two-front conflict.
why_uncontested: The two-front campaign is a settled fact; war-origin attribution is the dispute.

contested_claim: The Roman Empire fell chiefly from internal decay.
proposed_consensual: The Western Roman Empire ended while the Eastern Roman Empire endured.
why_uncontested: Chronological fact; the cause of the fall is the dispute.

contested_claim: Britain's high wages and cheap coal underpinned the Industrial Revolution.
proposed_consensual: Britain's coal output expanded steadily throughout the Industrial Revolution.
why_uncontested: Output series; the causal role of wages and coal is the dispute.

contested_claim: Text form alone supports linguistic meaning learning independent of sensory grounding.
proposed_consensual: Text form alone supports next-token prediction without any sensory input.
why_uncontested: Engineering fact; whether meaning is learned is the dispute.

contested_claim: In-context learning retrieves memorized patterns rather than learning new rules.
proposed_consensual: In-context learning performs better with more worked examples in the prompt.
why_uncontested: Robust empirical regularity; the mechanism is the dispute.
